reason: The document-chasing part is exactly my evening problem, but 2,400 plus 140 a month is over 4,000 EUR in the first year, more than a tenth of what the whole firm bills, and half of it is paying for a website I don't need because my clients come from people I meet at things like this conference, not from Google.
objection: I'm being asked to lock in for 12 months with a man who does this 10-12 hours a week next to a day job, and I don't believe an AI can pre-check eligibility for grant calls whose criteria change with every new session and every ministry order; one wrong 'eligible' sent to a farmer and I'm the one who looks like a fool.
would_change_my_mind: Sell me only the two automations, without the site, for a few hundred euros setup and under 60 a month, and let me call one consultant in Bihor who has used the document-upload link with actual farmers for at least three months.
